ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Mobile is entered in correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.AdobeIntegrationUserName)), OR( AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead',Text(Status) != 'Outcome',Text(Lead_Outcome__c) != 'Expired'), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead',Text(Status) != 'Expired',OR(ISNEW(),ISCHANGED(MobilePhone))) ), NOT ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) , AND(NOT REGEX( MobilePhone , "^\\+614[0-9]{8}+$" ), NOT REGEX( MobilePhone , "^\\+615[0-9]{8}+$" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Mobile Phone entered is not in the correct format. Refer to help text.
